idea-plugin.name: Call Stack Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Captures a debugger's call stack — frames and variables — the moment a breakpoint is hit, and persists it independently of the debug session's lifetime.

When a remote debug session times out or drops (network blip, server restart, session lease expiry), the call stack and locals are normally gone for good, forcing you to reproduce the conditions and re-hit the same breakpoint. This plugin keeps a snapshot around so you can keep inspecting it after the JVM on the other end is long gone.

Features:

  • "Save Call Stack" action, available whenever a debug session is suspended
  • Optional automatic capture on every breakpoint pause
  • Persists thread(s), frames (class, method, file, line), and locals as string previews, to a configurable depth
  • A "Call Stack Explorer" tool window laid out like the Debug tool window: Call Stacks (snapshots, frames, variables) and Values tabs
  • Double-click a frame to jump straight to that source line
  • Snapshots survive IDE restart — stored on disk per project
  • "Save Value to Call Stack Explorer" on selected variables in the debugger's Variables view
  • Compare two snapshots, or a snapshot against the live paused debugger, in a variables tree styled like the debugger's, with changed values highlighted
  • Export a comparison as an HTML page or text, to share as evidence
  • Progress notice in the bottom-right corner when a capture is slow
  • AI assistant access: "Copy for AI Assistant", plus an opt-in local MCP server for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Save selected object values from the debugger's Variables view
  • Redesigned tool window like the Debug tool window: Call Stacks and Values tabs, frames and variables panes
  • Compare snapshots with each other or with the current debug session, shown like the debugger's Variables view (JVM object ids ignored); each comparison opens in its own closable tab
  • Export comparisons as HTML or text for sharing
  • Bottom-right progress notice for slow captures; captures can now be cancelled
  • Copy snapshots as Markdown for AI chats, and an opt-in localhost MCP server exposing debugger state to AI assistants
  • Plugin errors can be reported to the developer from the IDE's error dialog
  • Faster deleting and pruning of snapshots; supports IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and newer

0.1.0

  • Initial release: manual and auto-capture of call stacks on breakpoint pause
  • Call Stack Explorer tool window with snapshot/thread/frame/variable tree and source navigation
